existing_rules.title: Forecast Cash and Financing Must Reconcile
existing_rules.rule_text: For every forecast period, reconcile opening cash plus operating, investing and financing cash flows and separately identified FX or scope changes to closing cash on the forecast balance sheet. Reconcile new borrowing, repayments and equity issuance to debt balances, equity and dilution. State the cash definition and rounding tolerance; bridge restricted cash, held-for-sale cash and overdrafts included in cash equivalents explicitly, without double counting. An unresolved material residual invalidates the forecast and dependent valuation; missing inputs are NOT VERIFIED, never PASS. Example: opening 100 + operating 20 - capex 10 + financing 5 = closing 115 passes; opening 100 plus net change -815 cannot produce closing 95 without an explicit 810 reconciling inflow.

existing_rules.title: Statutory Operating Cash Flow to FCFF/FCFE Bridge & Capex/Lease Deduction
existing_rules.rule_text: Prohibits labeling statutory Cash Generated from Operations (before capex, lease principal repayments, and interest) as Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE) or Free Cash Flow to Firm (FCFF). Models must explicitly bridge operating cash flow to true free cash flow by deducting replacement and expansion capex, IFRS 16 lease principal repayments, net finance costs, and working capital normalizations.

existing_rules.title: Cross-Section HEPS, Multiple & Target Price Identity
existing_rules.rule_text: Compute your Section 3 (P&L and HEPS) and Section 4 (DCF and P/E / EV/EBITDA valuation) numbers BEFORE writing the Section 1 Executive Summary Card commentary. The 12-Month Target Price, Reference Price, Forecast HEPS (e.g. FY27E HEPS in R or cents), and Target P/E or EV/EBITDA multiple cited in the Section 1 Executive Summary Card 'Basis & Key Commentary' cell MUST be 100% identical to Section 3 and Section 4 (never cite one HEPS/multiple in Section 1 commentary and a different HEPS/multiple in Section 4).

existing_rules.title: DCF Schedule Reproducibility & Anti-Handwaving Component Bridge
existing_rules.rule_text: Mandates explicit disclosure of annual forecast FCFF/FCFE, terminal value, WACC/discount rate, and a step-by-step numerical EV-to-Equity bridge. Forbids applying qualitative, unmodeled percentage uplifts to blended valuation components; any adjustment between underlying component valuations (e.g. DCF and P/E) and the published target price must be modeled directly within the underlying cash flows or valuation multiples.

existing_rules.title: Full Legal Entity Name Verification Across Notes (No Acronym Conflation)
existing_rules.rule_text: Never abbreviate two distinct legal entities to the same acronym and claim an accounting classification contradiction. When evaluating entities with similar names, acronyms, or operating divisions, always compare and cross-check full legal entity names across notes before concluding on whether an entity is a joint venture, joint operation, associate, or subsidiary.

existing_rules.title: Ordinary Shareholder NAV versus Contributed Capital
existing_rules.rule_text: Calculate statutory ordinary book value/NAV per share from equity attributable to parent ordinary shareholders, excluding non-controlling interests and preference or other non-ordinary claims, divided by ordinary shares outstanding net of treasury shares at the same measurement date. Reconcile retained earnings or accumulated losses and reserves; never label contributed share capital alone as NAV. Use date-matched closing shares rather than silently substituting an earnings weighted-average denominator. Adjusted or tangible NAV is permitted only when clearly labelled and reconciled to statutory ordinary equity, with every adjustment disclosed. NAV is not automatically market fair value. Example: parent ordinary equity 1,329 million / 780.651033 million net shares = approximately 1.70 ZAR/share; share capital 5,410 million / those shares is not book NAV.

existing_rules.title: Mandatory Historical Actuals Base Column & Currency Unit Consistency
existing_rules.rule_text: In Section 2 (Operational Forecast) and Section 3 (Income Statement & Cash Flow Bridge), always include the reported historical base period column(s) (e.g. FY25A and/or 1H26A) alongside FY26E, FY27E, and FY28E so annualized run-rates, operating expenses, and margins are anchored to audited actuals. Never label a ZAR-converted segment revenue row as EUR'm or USD'm; ensure every row's currency unit label matches the numbers in that row.

existing_rules.title: IFRS 16 EV-to-Equity & Cash Flow Consistency
existing_rules.rule_text: Never mix Pre-IFRS 16 cash flows/EBITDA with Post-IFRS 16 lease debt in an Enterprise Value (EV) to Equity bridge. If EV is derived by discounting or applying a multiple to Pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA/FCFF (where cash lease rental payments are already deducted as an operating outflow), DO NOT subtract capitalised IFRS 16 lease liabilities again in the EV-to-Equity bridge (and do not subtract lease principal payments a second time in FCFE). Conversely, if subtracting net IFRS 16 lease liabilities in the EV bridge, you must discount Post-IFRS 16 EBITDA/FCFF before lease payments. Always state explicitly whether your valuation bridge is on a Pre-IFRS 16 or Post-IFRS 16 basis.

existing_rules.title: Withhold Valuation Until Material Dependencies Are Resolved
existing_rules.rule_text: If a material cash-flow, forecast, financing, share-count, portfolio or valuation dependency fails reconciliation or remains unsupported, return VALUATION WITHHELD - MATERIAL ISSUES UNRESOLVED. Preserve verified historical analysis and risks, identify each blocker and the evidence or correction needed, and carry unresolved Stage 1 findings forward. Do not publish a target, rating bands, upside, dividend yield, TSR or investment recommendation; use JSON null, never zero or HOLD. Illustrative scenarios must remain clearly conditional and separate from the headline valuation. READY requires explicit source evidence, consistent periods and scopes, cash/debt/portfolio roll-forwards, equity financing and terminal-policy consistency, valuation-bridge and sensitivity checks. Assumptions may be used when supported and disclosed; they cannot conceal material missing inputs. Application checks of declared evidence and numeric reconciliations do not replace independent review.

existing_rules.title: Forecast PAT-to-HEPS Reconciliation & Net Finance Sign Integrity
existing_rules.rule_text: Forecast HEPS (cents) MUST equal (Forecast Headline Earnings in R'm / Weighted-Average Shares in millions * 100) and move directionally with Forecast PAT unless explicit non-headline items (e.g. PPE/investment property fair-value gains or goodwill impairments) are itemized in the bridge. Never forecast a sharp drop in PAT alongside an unexplained rise in HEPS. Also verify whether historical Net Finance is net finance income (+, e.g. when JV finance income exceeds P&L finance cost after interest capitalisation) or net finance expense (-), and preserve the exact sign so the P&L sums vertically.

existing_rules.title: Statutory vs. Normalized P&L Vertical Arithmetic & Impairment Bridge
existing_rules.rule_text: Every income statement table must sum vertically line-by-line (Revenue - Cost of sales = Gross profit; Gross profit + Other revenue/income - Net operating expenses = Operating profit). Always verify from the primary AFS notes whether statutory Operating Profit is already stated AFTER impairments, restructuring, or extraordinary items before subtracting them; never subtract Note 7/exceptional impairments a second time from a statutory Operating Profit that already includes them, and ensure historical continuing PAT and HEPS match the statutory AFS reconciliation identically.

existing_rules.title: Strictly Ascending ZAR Rating Bands
existing_rules.rule_text: In the opening JSON block and Section 1 table, rating_bands thresholds MUST be strictly ascending in ZAR per share: strong_buy_max_zar < buy_max_zar < hold_max_zar < sell_max_zar == strong_sell_above_zar, anchored around target_price_zar (Strong Buy <= Target/1.30, Buy <= Target/1.15, Hold <= Target/0.95, Sell <= Target/0.85, Strong Sell > Target/0.85). Never output identical ZAR values for Hold and Sell thresholds.

existing_rules.title: Sensitivity Cells Must Reproduce the Valuation
existing_rules.rule_text: Recalculate every sensitivity cell using the same documented base valuation formula, changing only the named inputs. The central case MUST reproduce the published base target within a declared rounding tolerance. Preserve debt, share count, cash-flow basis, valuation bridges and all discounts unless explicitly varied. Show the formula and full transformation for any additional haircut; unexplained cells invalidate the sensitivity conclusions. Nonlinear models are allowed when their actual formulas are used; do not impose constant derivatives from another method. Missing formulas or inputs are NOT VERIFIED. Example: with 3,845 million of PBD assets, a 0.05 multiple change and one 25% discount over 780.7 million shares imply a 0.18469 ZAR/share change; 0.07 without a disclosed transformation fails. This supplements SOTP arithmetic and prohibits double counting adjustments.

existing_rules.title: Verified Weighted-Average Share Count & Continuing HEPS Denominator
existing_rules.rule_text: Always extract and state the exact basic and diluted weighted-average number of ordinary shares (in millions, net of treasury shares) from the AFS EPS/HEPS note. Never confuse Headline Earnings in R'm with the share count in millions. In Stage 2 Section 3, include an explicit 'Weighted-Average Shares (m)' row immediately above 'Continuing HEPS (cents)', divide Continuing Headline Earnings (excluding discontinued operations and capital/Note 7 items) by that exact share count, and verify that full-year forecast HEPS is consistent with H1 continuing HEPS already banked.

existing_rules.title: Strict SOTP Vertical Arithmetic & Prohibition of DCF + Working Capital Double-Counting
existing_rules.rule_text: In Section 4 SOTP / DCF valuation tables, every component row MUST sum vertically to Total Enterprise Value (TEV), Equity Value (TEV less Net Debt), SOTP Fair Value per Share (Equity Value / Net Shares), and Target Price (ZAR). If a percentage risk/liquidity discount is applied (e.g. 25% discount), the discount ZAR per share and resulting Target Price MUST equal SOTP Fair Value per Share * (1 - discount%); never switch denominators mid-table. Never add book working capital (Inventory, Contract Assets/WIP) or Goodwill on top of a segment DCF/NPV that already discounts the cash flows generated by those operating assets.

existing_rules.title: Gross vs. Net Treasury Share Count & Parent vs. Consolidated Dividend Reconciliation
existing_rules.rule_text: Before flagging an arithmetic discrepancy between parent-company dividends paid/declared and net shares in issue, always check gross issued shares vs treasury shares held by subsidiaries or share trusts (e.g. in the Integrated Report dividend declaration or Stated Capital note). Under South African corporate law, the parent company pays the gross dividend on all gross issued shares, whereas the Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity and Cash Flow Statement eliminate intra-group dividends paid on treasury shares.

existing_rules.title: Consumer Lending IFRS 9 Stage Migration & Purchased Book Debt (PBD) Amortization
existing_rules.rule_text: Reconcile gross loan book and Purchased Book Debt (PBD) carrying values against Estimated Remaining Collections (ERC), separating cash collections applied to revenue yield vs principal amortization and Stage 1/2/3 ECL coverage.

existing_rules.title: Purchased Book Debt (PBD) Amortisation Exclusion from Operating Cash Flow
existing_rules.rule_text: When valuing consumer debt purchasers and collectors, models are strictly prohibited from treating PBD amortisation as a non-cash add-back in Free Cash Flow to Equity (FCFE). Because portfolio replenishments (PBD acquisitions) are required to sustain collections, models must reflect net cash collections after portfolio acquisition reinvestment.

existing_rules.title: POCI Cumulative Gains, Loss Allowances and Portfolio Scope
existing_rules.rule_text: For purchased or originated credit-impaired (POCI) principal portfolios, identify the acquisition baseline and reconcile gross carrying amount, signed cumulative changes in lifetime expected credit losses, and net carrying amount using the original notes. A favourable cumulative impairment gain is NOT a conventional loss-coverage reserve: do not divide it by gross carrying amount and call the result loss coverage or describe its decline as a coverage collapse. Preserve reported labels such as ECL allowance while explaining their economic sign. Reconcile opening balance, gains or losses on new and historical portfolios, and closing balance. Separate amortised-cost POCI principal portfolios from other purchased-book-debt assets measured at FVTPL; do not apply one ECL regime to both. Example: gross 3,414 plus cumulative gain 431 = net 3,845; 431/3,414 is not conventional loss coverage. A rolling 12-month modelling disclosure warrants a lifetime/tail-methodology check, not an unsupported conclusion about the amount or direction of misstatement. Missing methodology is NOT VERIFIED.

assessment: No same-code or simplified-trade-receivables rule. Complements POCI gain/scope, cash reconciliation and withholding; no existing rules changed.
